example_dialogues.text_b: I am upset because I have to bake a cake again. I always check the temperature of the oven before baking but this morning I forgot and it was such a silly mistake.
I am angry because I have to whisk the cream again. I always chill the bowl but this morning I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am tired because I have to knead a large batch of dough again. I always oil my hands before kneading but today I forgot and my feet already hurt after standing for so long.

dialogues.text_b: I am angry because I have to temper the chocolate again. I always check the thermometer carefully but today I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am tired because I have to do the pastry again. I always measure the warm water exactly but today I forgot and my feet already hurt after standing for so long.
I am upset because I have to glaze all the pastries again. I always do it carefully but today it got clotted and it was such a silly mistake.
I am angry because I have to blend the fruit purée again. I always remove the seeds before blending but today I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am upset because I have to decorate all the cupcakes again. I always prepare the icing bags in advance but today I forgot and it was such a silly mistake.
I am tired because I have to slice a lot of vegetables. I always get different duties to do, but today I got only this and my feet already hurt after standing for so long.

activity_b.text: Good morning, Mala. Nice to meet you.
Good morning, Madam. How are you today?
Please relax and take a seat.
Quite good. I’m looking forward to talking to you about my career.
Let’s start with something simple then.
Tell me, what do you know about our company?
Last night I read about your company on the Internet.
I saw that you expanded a dairy-processing line in Anuradhapura and that you focus strongly on hygiene and quality.
I also liked the way you use automated mixers and thermostatic controls.
I’m glad you checked it.
Now, before we talk about your skills, tell me—what do you like most in the food-processing field?
Honestly, Madam, I like seeing consistent results.
When we weigh ingredients, adjust temperatures, or monitor fermentation, I can see the changes immediately.
I also enjoy working with a team.
That’s a good attitude.
And what tasks are you good at?
I am good at portioning ingredients and checking product quality.
During my training, I operated small mixers, monitored pasteurisation steps, and helped the instructor label storage batches.
And what technical skills do you have?
I know how to read simple processing charts, measure temperatures, and use tools like digital thermometers, pH metres, and stainless-steel scoops.
Last month, I corrected an inconsistent mixture in the workshop.
We sometimes use programmable batch controllers.
Are you familiar with them?
I am not familiar with them, Madam, but I can read about them on the Internet.
That’s how I learned more about controlling viscosity.
Excellent.
Finally, why should we select you?
Because I learn fast, I work diligently, and I’m always ready to support the team.
Well said, Mala. We’ll contact you soon.
